conflicts.permit: We may disclose User Provided and Automatically Collected Information: as required by law, such as to comply with a subpoena, or similar legal process; when we believe in good faith that disclosure is necessary to protect our rights, protect your safety or the safety of others, investigate fraud, or respond to a government request; with our trusted services providers who work on our behalf, do not have an independent use of the information we disclose to them, and have agreed to adhere to the rules set forth in this privacy statement.
conflicts.prohibit: Only aggregated, anonymized data is periodically transmitted to external services to help us improve the Application and our service.
conflicts.situation: Sharing identifiable user or automatically collected data with external service providers to improve the application or service.
conflicts.reason: One sentence limits external transmissions strictly to aggregated, anonymized data, while the other permits disclosing unaggregated User Provided and Automatically Collected Information to trusted service providers.
